name: hope
description: Align before implementation and preserve the agreed intent, sweep codebase maintenance, challenge work with evidence, understand pull requests, and improve writing. Requires Node.js 22 or newer.

interface.shortDescription: Practical ways for people and AI to work better together
interface.longDescription: Align finds important misunderstandings before implementation and preserves the person's intent without solution or implementation details. Explicitly invoked Sweep removes proven codebase waste while preserving customer-observed behavior. Toxic Review challenges work with evidence and clear priorities. Diff explains code changes so you can decide. Write improves language without changing its meaning.
defaultPrompt: Use $hope:align to build a shared understanding before implementation.
Use $hope:sweep to remove proven codebase waste without changing customer-observed behavior.
Use $hope:diff to explain the current pull request.
